title: Ginni Helida Kathe
desc: Cab driver Gini and passenger Ammu forge an instant bond over life's quirks. Soon, their chat reveals an unexpected link in Gini's tale.

title: Bangarada Manushya
desc: Rajeeva is shocked when he finds out that his brother-in-law has passed away leaving his family in financial trouble. He decides to take on the responsibility of supporting his sister's family.

title: Mayura
desc: Mayura, a Brahmin boy, discovers his connections to the royal family. He then takes it upon himself to avenge the death of his father and works towards building his kingdom.

title: Yajamana
desc: Devi Shetty, a cruel gangster, is out to plunder a village's oil resources and ruin its inhabitants' livelihood. However, the son-in-law of the village head, Krishna, stands in his way.

title: Seetharama Kalyana
desc: Arya, a righteous man, falls in love with a small-town woman named Geetha, unaware of the obstacles that lie ahead for both of them.

title: Kalyanam Kamaneeyam
desc: Shiva and Shruti are in love and get married. However, after marriage, when he finds difficulty in finding employment, it sours their relationship.
